policy: Maps every source architecture row and every currently catalogued instruction form to Linux/Windows/macOS host toolchain candidates. This is not a claim that every architecture has a native OS kernel, complete compiler, full assembler/disassembler, emulator, or tested binary. Host OS toolchains, guest ISA, object ABI, and runtime support are separate dimensions.
